decisions.reason: The infectious waste plant is close to the core WASTX line, backed by the ERMAFA partnership and presented as a flagship, and it is still within its evaluation window, so the firm keeps it rather than starting problemistic search, though weak visibility after launch raises some risk.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is a low-cost modular extension that fits the decentralized strategy, and the firm is still growing with slack after dropping A and B, so there is no shortfall pressure to cut it.
